finding: Each additive component has a deterministic point-in-time calculation proof and an explicit prose falsifier, but the repository has no period-aware adapter that joins issuer filings, court or municipal entitlement records, and debt maturity records to those component proofs.

historical_replay.method: The registered dispositions were checked against the current component identifiers, calculation-proof lineage, and existing falsifier text. No numeric forecast was inferred or backfilled.

required_follow_up: Implement the named source adapters before replacing these dispositions with testable ex-ante forecasts.
decision_authority: This review closes only the prospective typed-coverage gate. It does not resolve the carried-forward committee questions or authorize capital.
